development_population: frozen Gate 4 primary and secondary memberships, reported separately where applicable
objective: improve correctly targeted, useful, grounded documentation coverage without maximizing raw output count
selection_sequence: Select retrieval top-k on controlled target-document evidence using Hit@3, then MRR, then Hit@1, then smaller lexical top-k, then smaller dense top-k. Execute the minimum 0.35 threshold once per prompt and derive stricter threshold dispositions without rerunning model inference. Do not select P1/P2 from self-critic scores alone; if deterministic diagnostics do not resolve them, freeze a blind development review sample and request authorization before workbook creation.
target_metrics_policy: Hit@k/MRR only on development rows with legitimate target-document evidence; never invent natural target gold
human_review_policy: If manual development review becomes necessary, freeze a blind sample and ask before creating its workbook
stop_conditions: pre-change reconstruction unavailable for most cases
